integrated_multimodal_description:

Photorealistic live-action Chinese family drama.
Vertical 9:16.
Total duration: approximately 9.8 seconds.

PART 1 OF 4.

DIRECTOR GOAL:
Establish the house entrance, the girl, the uncle, and the door relationship clearly.
This segment must show that the girl comes to visit her aunt with gifts.

CONTINUITY:
S1 is the same young Chinese girl with low ponytail, light blue-gray jacket, white inner shirt, dark pants, white sneakers, black backpack, carrying three red gift boxes.
S2 is the same middle-aged Chinese man with short black hair, dark-gray polo shirt, black trousers.

LOCATION:
Outside the aunt's apartment door and at the doorway threshold.
Brown apartment door, cream-colored corridor wall, warm interior household light visible inside.

CRITICAL AUDIO:
One speaker at a time.
No overlapping dialogue.
Only the active speaker moves lips.
No subtitles.
No visible text.

--------------------------------
SHOT 1
00:00.000–00:01.300
--------------------------------

Medium-wide shot outside the apartment door.

START:
S1 stands outside the door, holding three red gift boxes, backpack on shoulders.

MOTION:
She knocks twice and leans slightly forward.

S1 says:

<d>[Chinese] 姑姑！</d>

END:
She finishes speaking and waits.

--------------------------------
SHOT 2
00:01.300–00:03.900
--------------------------------

The brown door opens.

S2 appears inside the doorway.

S1 looks a little surprised that it is him instead of her aunt.

S1 asks politely:

<d>[Chinese] 哎，姑父，我姑姑在家吗？</d>

S2 listens silently until she finishes.

--------------------------------
SHOT 3
00:03.900–00:06.200
--------------------------------

Medium close-up of S2 in the doorway.

His expression becomes impatient.

S2 says:

<d>[Chinese] 你怎么又来了？你姑姑不在家。</d>

His tone is cold and dismissive, but natural.

--------------------------------
SHOT 4
00:06.200–00:09.800
--------------------------------

No dialogue.

S1 looks a little disappointed but still polite.

She lowers the red gift boxes slightly in her arms and glances into the house, as if thinking whether to leave or continue.

S2 remains at the doorway, blocking the entrance, looking impatient.

Hold the tension and end the segment at this decision point.

ABSOLUTELY NO VISIBLE TEXT:

No subtitles.

No logo.
No watermark.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.200 室内半身特写，镜头稳定。女孩仍坐桌前，右手从下巴缓缓滑至锁骨处，神态略带妩媚，眼神直视镜头。高马尾随头部微动产生自然惯性摆动，发丝细节清晰。沙漏型身材在坐姿中展现自然重心分布，胸部与臀部随姿态产生符合重力的轻微次级位移，衣料褶皱随动作自然变化。

[Shot 3] At 00:02.400 室内场景切换至绿植墙背景前。女孩站立，挺胸侧身展现沙漏型曲线，随后单手叉腰回眸看向镜头。走路与转身时重心转移自然，胸部与臀部随动作产生克制的惯性次级运动，高马尾甩动后回弹，白色短裤与腰带贴合身体轮廓，高跟鞋拉长腿部线条。镜头轻微环绕跟随。

[Shot 4] At 00:03.800 户外半开放连廊，绿植环绕，自然光柔和。女孩站在路中央，双手举起整理高马尾，动作充满活力。转身时衣料随惯性飘动，沙漏型身材动态自然，胸部受服装支撑产生符合动作幅度的轻微摆动，腹部结构稳定无漂移。镜头保持中景跟拍。

[Shot 5] At 00:05.000 切回室内白桌旁。女孩一手轻放胸前，另一手撑桌，身体微微前倾注视镜头，姿态定格。眼神稳定，表情略带诱惑。高马尾静止，发丝细节清晰。沙漏型身材前倾时重心前移自然，胸部与臀部随姿态产生符合重力的微妙位移，腹部与腰线连续过渡保持稳定。镜头轻微推近后定格。
